model_pinning.pinning: a version id as `model` (docs.typesafe.ai/models.md); on 2026-09-19 a request pinned to jev-1.13.0 was answered by jev-1.13.0
model_pinning.served: every answer's `model` must be jev-1.13.0; any other stops the whole cohort

gateway: not used for the cohort: its answers carry no version, so it cannot be held to the pin

budget.credit: the latest TypeSafe console snapshot less the spend recorded since, until the expiry it showed; no paid credit

send_window: from the S0 session end plus twice Yahoo's delay (every bar final, D-262) until 09:00 JST on the next weekday (the earliest S1 can open)

screener.definition: Routes A-H (route-1.0.0) on features-1.0.0, replayed point-in-time at S0; material routes M1-M6 and Stage 2 are not replayed

definition.base: S0 close as traded (split restatement undone)
definition.window: S1..S20, T+n = n-th market session after S0
definition.share_basis: prices after S0 restated to S0's share count
definition.hit_20_high: some intraday high in S1..S20 >= base x 1.20
definition.hit_20_close: some close in S1..S20 >= base x 1.20
definition.max_upside: max high (and max close) in S1..S20 / base - 1
definition.max_drawdown: min low (and min close) in S1..S20 / base - 1
definition.missing: a session without a bar makes the outcome UNRESOLVED_MISSING_DATA; nothing is filled in
definition.label_status: neither hit definition is the label (D-268); not merged with success_label

decision_interpretation.decision: answers.decision.choice as returned (ENTRY / WATCH_BREAKOUT / WATCH_PULLBACK / WATCH_OTHER / REJECT); no code-side override
decision_interpretation.reaches_target: answers.reaches_target.noul as returned, the probability of yes; no probability threshold
decision_interpretation.upside: answers.upside_band.score and its probabilities as returned
decision_interpretation.confidence: recorded as returned; no confidence threshold, never used to filter or re-weight
decision_interpretation.repeats: one answer per sample; drift repeats are measured apart and never averaged into it
decision_interpretation.raw_output: kept as it came beside each record

route_d_subgroups.D_ONLY: Route D is the only route that fired
route_d_subgroups.D_PLUS_OTHER: Route D fired together with at least one other route
route_d_subgroups.NON_D: at least one route fired, Route D did not

preregistered.route_d_handling: Route D's thresholds and definition are unchanged; D-only candidates are drawn like any other (no exclusion, no down-weighting); changes are considered only after Phase B
subgroup_metrics: reaches_target calibration (10 bins, ECE) and Brier, for +20% on the high and on the close
+20% hit rate, on the high and on the close
maximum future return (max upside on the high and on the close; mean, median)
maximum drawdown (on the low and on the close; mean, median)
preregistered.primary_metrics: Brier and Brier skill, calibration, PR-AUC, hit rate by decision, score against future return (Primary only); Control is a benchmark with hit rates only

not_introduced: averaging repeated answers (3-run or any other)
a code-side override of Jev's decision
